events.description: Corporate headquarters relocation to Newport Beach, California, consolidation of corporate functions in Columbus, Ohio, and closure of headquarters in Denver, Colorado and other corporate offices in New York City.
events.source_quote: In May 2018, we announced that we would open a headquarters office in Newport Beach, California, consolidate certain corporate administrative functions into our existing office in Columbus, Ohio, and close our existing headquarters offices in Denver, Colorado, as well as additional corporate offices in New York, New York.

events.description: Elizabeth Kelley filed a purported class action complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado on July 20, 2017, alleging failure to disclose material information regarding quality controls and safeguards in connection with foodborne illnesses at a Sterling, Virginia restaurant. The court granted Chipotle's motion to dismiss the case with prejudice on March 29, 2019.
events.source_quote: Additionally, on July 20, 2017, Elizabeth Kelley filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado on behalf of a purported class of purchasers of shares of our common stock between February 5, 2016 and July 19, 2017, with claims and factual allegations similar to the Ong complaint, based primarily on media reports regarding illnesses associated with a Chipotle restaurant in Sterling, Virginia. On March 29, 2019, the court granted our motion to dismiss, with prejudice.

events.description: Susie Ong filed a shareholder class action complaint in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York on January 8, 2016, alleging failure to disclose material quality control and safeguard information. Following dismissal with prejudice and denial of a motion for relief, the plaintiff initiated an appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit on December 20, 2018.
events.source_quote: On January 8, 2016, Susie Ong filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York on behalf of a purported class of purchasers of shares of our common stock between February 4, 2015 and January 5, 2016... On December 20, 2018, the plaintiff initiated an appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit.
